briefing.summary: A vast majority of researchers anticipate that artificial intelligence will quicken the pace of breakthroughs in their fields, according to a survey conducted by OpenAI. The study found that ninety-eight percent of participating scientists believe the technology can substantially reduce the time needed to achieve major findings.
briefing.whyItMatters: Strong confidence from scientists highlights the expanding impact of advanced machine learning systems in accelerating real-world research workflows.
